title: OPEX access as "VSB - Application Administrator": navigation, command states, rows, refused writes
preconditions: A test account holding ONLY the role "VSB - Application Administrator" (plus the base Cost-app access) is signed in to both apps on VSBCloud_Dev. Two projects asked at run time: one inside the role's Dataverse scope (read project) and one outside it, or a row the role may read but not write. Both projects have O&M and Other OPEX costs.
test_data: Write attempts use a Description prefixed "PW-<runId>"; any row that unexpectedly saves is deleted after the run (parity:sweep).
steps:
1. Canvas app, as the role: open the in-scope project, select "Operation & Maintenance" in the left navigation; note the device cards, the row count per card and the visible/enabled state of Add Period, Add Standard Contract, Edit and Delete with no row selected and with a non-standard root row selected.
2. Canvas app: select "Other OPEX Costs"; note the sub-account cards, row counts and the state of Add Contract Type, Add Period, Add Standard Contract, Edit and Delete with no row and with a row selected.
3. Code app, same account: open /costs/opex/om?projectId=<read project> from the left navigation AND through the launch parameters (projectId + costScreen=/costs/opex/om); repeat step 1. Then /costs/opex/other; repeat step 2.
4. Compare the card lists, row counts and command states with steps 1-2.
5. On the out-of-scope project (or a read-only row): try Add Period > fill a valid PW- period > Save, and Delete > Delete on a row. Note what each app shows.
6. Reload the code app and confirm no PW- row was written and no row was removed.
expected: Both apps reach the screen from the left navigation ("Operation & Maintenance", "Other OPEX Costs" under "OPEX"); the code app also from the deep link. The Cost app reads no role flag on this screen (gblCurrentUser.IsControllerOwnData / IsProjectDataAllCountries / EditableCounties are never read by Opex Costs Screen), so the role changes nothing in the UI itself: the same cards, the same rows per card and the same command states as the canvas for the same user and project; an Application Administrator is expected to read and write every project's OPEX costs, and this is decided by Dataverse security only. Exception, decided: the canvas greys Add Contract Type and Add Period through DataSourceInfo(CreatePermission) and Other-OPEX Edit/Delete through RecordInfo; the code app has no equivalent and keeps them enabled (D1 "server refuses, a 403 becomes a message"). A write outside the role's scope is refused by Dataverse and the code app shows it as an error message (save: the "Error: OPEX cost could not be saved correctly. ..." text or the error banner; delete: the screen's delete error), never as a silent success or as "no rows".
acceptance: Card titles AND row count per card equal the canvas (both tabs) AND each command's enabled state equals the canvas, except the D1 permission-gated commands AND the out-of-scope Save and Delete each show a visible error AND a reload shows 0 new PW- rows and 0 removed rows.
